notes.title: Some attempts we have made to optimize the gaming experience
notes.content:
Dear players, hello everyone, since the demo of Lunarium was launched, we have received a lot of enthusiastic gameplay and feedback from players, and we are very grateful. The most frequent feedback we have received since the demo was launched is that the feel and actions need improvement. We attach great importance to your feedback and have been researching and trying to optimize it since the demo was launched. At present, we have made the following adjustments to the combat actions:
[list]
[*] Enhanced the interrupt performance of the call shot action, now you can interrupt the current action at any time during the attack and use the call shot. You can also use the call shot immediately after dodging, and you can use defense at any time during the shooting action. It is hoped that this will improve the problem of the cumbersome coordination of attacks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984177/48ab89473091a9b5dc7a4e2cf0271702406c13bb.gif[/img]
[*] Additionally, we have optimized the animation of the attack action and adjusted the interrupt performance of many actions, hoping to improve the issue of sticky feedback from players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984177/fb34f6e79e63a5af06ce45c8110a075dd65faaa2.gif[/img]
[/list]
There are still many minor changes that will not be mentioned one by one. Our optimization will not stop here, and we will continue to accumulate experience, modify and optimize various gameplay and feel, hoping that the official version can bring everyone a better gaming experience.

notes.title: 0.4.5Beta Demo Patch Notes
notes.content:
This update represents a more polished version of the demo, with significant improvements to localization implementation. However, please note that the current translation quality remains provisional - the full release will feature completely revised translations.
We're deeply grateful to all players who have tested and provided feedback so far. We hope you enjoy the game!

• Added sound effects and VFX to the Skill Tree interface
• Optimized localization content accuracy
• Implemented menu functionality localization support
• Introduced collectible rewards in level exploration
• Added anti-misclick protection for dialogue choices/tutorial pop-ups (prevents instant closure)
• Improved animation transitions between attack and movement states
• Added a "Thank You for Playing" screen upon game completion
• Enhanced cinematic sequences after returning to the village hub
• Upgraded visual fidelity in key environmental scenes
• Fixed critical stability issues that could cause runtime crashes
• Reworked Focus mechanics:
 - Charged Attack now generates Focus
 - Stellar Thrust skill buffed with +1 Focus consumption

notes.title: 0.4.3 Beta Patch Notes
notes.content:
• Fixed an issue where the camera could remain locked in place after combat.
• Resolved several cases that could cause black screens when loading saved games.
• Added the ability to access the settings menu directly from in-game.
• Implemented an option to quit the game from the in-game settings menu.
• Added UI feedback for localization selection.

notes.title: Patch Notes 2025/02/17
notes.content:
• Fixed an issue where the bench save point would become corrupted after defeating the "Giant Plant Boss".
• Resolved a bug that could prevent proper respawning after dying during the "Giant Plant Boss" or subsequent boss fights.
• Addressed an issue causing incorrect load behavior when reopening the game after the "Giant Plant Boss" encounter.

notes.title: Nice to meet you. We are Lunarium Studio！
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are Lunarium Studio! We're thrilled to present our first sandbox-style fantasy action-adventure game "Star Journey" on Steam. If you enjoy our game, please add it to your wishlist - your support means everything to us. Thank you so much!

Since the start of development, we have received tremendous attention and support from our player community. With everyone's encouragement, we've made significant progress in development - improving many aspects compared to our initial offline debut, while adding and optimizing numerous features! Currently, we're accelerating development to release a demo during the upcoming festival for our official debut! Please hold on a little longer for us!
